result.description: A fictional pocket-sized digital recorder and playback vault designed for field poets, oral historians, and sound designers. It stores up to 64GB of lossless audio, tags clips with voice notes, and syncs over USB-C for quick transfer to editing software. The PrismDock emphasizes quiet operation, simple single-button capture, and long battery standby rather than rugged storage or high-capacity enterprise use.
result.title: NebulaQuill PrismDock 64GB Portable Audio Archive
